Common Questions

## Straight Answers to Real Questions

## What areas do you specialize in?

I specialize in San Tan Valley and Florence. I know these markets cold -- from the difference between communities like Pecan Creek and Johnson Ranch to which land parcels in Florence actually make sense. If you're buying or selling in these areas, I can give you straight answers based on actual local knowledge.

## Do you work with first-time buyers?

Absolutely. First-time buyers are honestly one of my favorite parts of this job. I'll walk you through the entire process, explain what you're actually buying, connect you with a great lender, and make sure you understand everything before you sign. No pressure, no rushing -- just honest guidance from start to close.

## What makes you different from other agents?

I don't believe in high-pressure sales tactics. I'm not going to rush you into decisions or tell you what you want to hear just to close a deal. My job is to show you exactly what you're buying, fight hard for you during negotiations, and make sure you understand these markets before you commit. Not just your agent -- your advocate.

## How do I get started?

Just call or text me at 480-810-9255, or email Brian@thebutlerrealty.com. We'll have a conversation about what you're looking for -- no obligation, no sales pitch. If working together makes sense, great. If not, that's fine too.

## About Brian

The person behind the business -- and why that matters

## Not Just Your Agent, Your Advocate

I'm Brian Butler with eXp Realty (License SA701819000), and I specialize in San Tan Valley and Florence real estate. 4 years licensed in Arizona real estate, focused exclusively on San Tan Valley and Florence.

If you're buying or selling in San Tan Valley or Florence, I know these markets cold. I know the difference between communities like Pecan Creek and Johnson Ranch, what land parcels in Florence actually make sense, which builders consistently deliver quality, and what homes are priced right versus what's been sitting too long.

Most of my clients are first-time buyers or people relocating to Arizona who want straight answers. No pressure, no sales pitch, no rushing you into decisions you're not ready for.

What I believe in: showing you exactly what you're buying, explaining what it means for your money, and fighting hard for you during negotiations. My job is to make sure you understand the San Tan Valley and Florence markets -- not just get you to sign paperwork.

One of my favorite parts of this job is handing first-time buyers the keys to their new home and watching their face light up. That moment never gets old.

Whether you're buying your first home in San Tan Valley, selling your property in Florence, or just have questions about these markets -- let's talk. No agenda. Just honest answers from someone who actually knows these areas.

"Brian is amazing to work with! His professionalism, communication skills, and work ethic are hard to beat. Additionally, he's an amazing local resource that is so knowledgeable. If you are looking to buy or sell a home in the San Tan Valley or Florence, AZ, this is your #1 Realtor!"
-- Courtney Twiss, Google review

## Buying a Home

Whether it's your first home or your fifth -- I'll make the process simple

## My Approach to Helping Buyers

Buying a home -- especially your first one -- should be exciting, not overwhelming. My job is to guide you through every step, protect your interests, and make sure you find a home that's right for YOU.

I will never push you toward a house you're not sure about. I will never rush your timeline. And I will always give you the honest truth about a property -- good and bad.

## What I Do For You

- Set up a custom MLS search that pulls listings in real time

- Schedule and attend all showings, pointing out pros AND cons

- Provide honest pricing guidance so you never overpay

- Write and negotiate your offer strategically

- Coordinate inspections and connect you with trusted professionals

- Monitor your loan process and keep all parties on track

- Guide you through closing with zero surprises

- Remain your real estate resource long after you have the keys

## PAGE: Sellers — https://thebutlerrealty.com/sellers

## Selling Your Home

Strategic marketing, honest pricing, and weekly communication -- that's my promise

## My Approach to Selling Your Home

Selling your home is one of the biggest financial decisions you'll make. You deserve an agent who tells you the truth, markets aggressively, and keeps you informed every single week. It starts with a detailed CMA (Comparative Market Analysis) so you know exactly where you stand.

I'd rather tell you a price you don't love and sell your home in 30 days than tell you what you want to hear and watch it sit for months. That's how I operate.

## My Marketing Plan

- Professional photography and video tour

- Targeted social media marketing to active buyers

- MLS listing with syndication to Zillow, Realtor.com, Redfin, and 100+ sites

- Direct outreach to agents with active buyers in your price range

- Strategic open houses to create urgency

- Weekly updates with showing feedback and market data

- Skilled negotiation to maximize your net proceeds

- Full transaction management from listing to closing

Community Spotlights

## Know the Neighborhoods, Not Just the City

San Tan Valley isn't one neighborhood — it's several distinct communities, each with its own character. Here's how the main ones compare.

## Pecan Creek
San Tan Valley

One of San Tan Valley's most established master-planned communities. Well-maintained common areas, community amenities, and a strong neighborhood feel. Typically draws families looking for a turnkey suburban experience.

TypeMaster-planned, HOA community

Best ForFamilies, community-oriented buyers

## Johnson Ranch
San Tan Valley

A large, established community with its own amenities including pools, sports courts, and walking trails. Known for its value and the variety of home sizes available. Popular with first-time buyers and growing families alike.

TypeLarge master-planned community

Best ForFirst-time buyers, value seekers

## Florence Land Parcels
Florence, AZ

Florence offers land parcel opportunities that have largely disappeared from closer-in markets. If you're looking to build, invest in raw land, or want acreage at a price that makes sense — Florence is worth a serious look.

TypeResidential lots & raw land

Best ForBuilders, investors, acreage buyers

## PAGE: San Tan Valley — https://thebutlerrealty.com/areas/san-tan-valley

## San Tan Valley, Arizona

Space, Value, and Room to Grow One of Arizona's Fastest-Growing Communities

Neighborhood Spotlight

## Why Families Are Choosing San Tan Valley

More home for your money, newer construction, and wide-open desert skies — San Tan Valley delivers what a lot of East Valley buyers are searching for.

## Newer Homes & Larger Lots

Most of San Tan Valley's housing stock was built in the 2000s and later, meaning you get modern floor plans, open layouts, and bigger yards at prices that would be impossible closer to the metro core.

## Serious Value

Price ranges typically run $300K–$450K+, making San Tan Valley one of the most affordable places in the greater Phoenix area to get a 3- or 4-bedroom home with a real backyard.

## Growth & Investment

San Tan Valley is one of the fastest-growing communities in Arizona. New retail, schools, and infrastructure continue to follow the growth — making it an attractive long-term investment.

## Desert Living Done Right

Backed by the San Tan Mountains and the San Tan Regional Park, residents enjoy hiking, mountain biking, and stunning Sonoran Desert scenery right out the back gate.

## Schools & Community

Served by the J.O. Combs Unified School District with newer campuses built to serve growing families. A strong sense of community runs through neighborhoods throughout the area.

🛣️

## Commuter Access

US-60 and AZ-24 connect San Tan Valley to the broader East Valley. If you work in Queen Creek, Gilbert, or Mesa, the commute is very manageable — and remote work has made it even more attractive.

Market Snapshot

## San Tan Valley by the Numbers

Typical Price Range$300K–$450K+

Home StyleSingle-family, newer builds

Lot Sizes6,000–12,000+ sq ft

School DistrictJ.O. Combs Unified

Best ForFamilies wanting more space

VibeSuburban, growing, community-oriented

## Is San Tan Valley Right for You?

San Tan Valley tends to be the sweet spot for buyers who want:

- More home for their budget

- A newer home with modern finishes

- A real yard and open space

- A quieter, less congested lifestyle

- Room to grow as the area develops

If that sounds like you, let's talk. I know this market well and can help you find the right neighborhood within San Tan Valley — not just the right house.

## Thinking About San Tan Valley?

I've worked with buyers all over San Tan Valley and know the neighborhoods, the builders, and the market. Let's have a real conversation about whether this is the right fit for your goals.

## San Tan Valley Communities

Not all of San Tan Valley is the same. Here's how the main communities compare:

- Pecan Creek — Established master-planned, strong HOA, community amenities

- Johnson Ranch — Large community, pools, trails, great value range

Ask me which one makes the most sense for your goals -- I know the difference between them and can save you a lot of time.

See All Areas ->

Common Questions

## Straight Answers About San Tan Valley

## What's the difference between Pecan Creek and Johnson Ranch?

Both are great communities, but they have a different feel. Pecan Creek tends to attract buyers looking for a quieter, more established neighborhood. Johnson Ranch has more amenities -- a golf course, multiple pools, and a stronger HOA presence. The right one depends on what you actually want in a neighborhood, and I've helped buyers choose between them enough times to walk you through it clearly.

## Is San Tan Valley a good place to buy right now?

In my opinion, yes -- but it depends on what you're looking for. San Tan Valley still offers more space for the money than most parts of the Phoenix metro. Inventory moves, and there are still deals if you know where to look. I won't oversell it -- there are some areas I'd steer you away from and others I'd point you toward. Call me and I'll give you a straight read on the current market.

## Do you only work in San Tan Valley, or other areas too?

San Tan Valley is my primary market, but I also specialize in Florence. Between those two, I cover a lot of ground -- residential homes, land parcels, new construction, and resale. If you're looking somewhere outside those areas, I'll be upfront about whether I'm the right fit or whether you'd be better served by someone with deeper local knowledge in that specific market.

## PAGE: Florence — https://thebutlerrealty.com/areas/florence

## Florence, Arizona

Maximum Space, Small-Town Living Residential Homes & Land Parcels

Market Spotlight

## Why Buyers Are Looking at Florence

Brian Butler is a licensed Arizona REALTOR® specializing in Florence real estate. If you're looking for more space, more land, and more value than the metro can deliver — Florence is worth a serious look.

## Most Space Per Dollar

Florence consistently offers the best value per square foot and per acre in the greater Phoenix region. Residential homes typically run $220K–$380K+, and land parcels are available at price points that have largely disappeared from closer-in markets.

## Land Parcel Opportunities

Florence is one of the few areas near Phoenix where land purchases still make financial sense. Whether you want to build, invest in raw land, or own acreage — Florence has options. I know which parcels are worth looking at and which ones to skip.

## Newer Construction

Much of Florence's residential inventory was built in the 2000s and later, meaning you get modern floor plans, open layouts, and larger lot sizes at prices that feel like a different era compared to the metro core.

## Small-Town Atmosphere

Florence has a genuine small-town character that's increasingly rare in fast-growing Arizona. It attracts remote workers, retirees, and buyers who want space and quiet without sacrificing access to the greater Phoenix area when needed.

## Remote Work Friendly

The rise of remote work has made Florence significantly more attractive. If you don't commute daily, Florence delivers a lifestyle upgrade at a fraction of the cost of metro options. Strong Arizona sunshine, open skies, and your own land.

## Location & Access

Florence sits in Pinal County southeast of the Phoenix metro. State Route 79 connects you to the greater area. It's further out — that's part of the tradeoff — but for the right buyer, the distance is worth the value and space you get in return.

Market Snapshot

## Florence by the Numbers

Residential Price Range$220K–$380K+

Home StyleSingle-family, newer builds

Lot Sizes6,000 sq ft – multiple acres

CountyPinal County

Land ParcelsAvailable — ask for current options

VibeSmall-town, spacious, quiet

## Is Florence Right for You?

Florence tends to be a strong fit for buyers who want:

- Maximum space and land for their budget

- Remote work lifestyle with occasional metro access

- Land parcel investment or build-your-own opportunity

- A quieter, less congested pace of life

- Newer construction at prices that make sense

Florence isn't for everyone — and I'll tell you honestly if it's not the right fit for your situation. But if any of the above sounds like you, let's talk.

Common Questions

## Straight Answers About Florence

## Can I buy land in Florence, Arizona?

Yes -- and Florence is one of the few places near Phoenix where land still makes financial sense. Parcels range from residential lots to larger acreage, and they attract buyers looking to build, invest, or own land at a price point that's disappeared from closer-in markets. I know which parcels are worth pursuing and which ones have issues you'd only discover after the fact. Give me a call before you start looking on your own.

## What should I know before buying in Florence?

A few honest things: Florence is further from the metro core than San Tan Valley, so the commute matters if you're in the office regularly. The small-town atmosphere is real -- this isn't a place with walkable shopping and restaurant rows. But if you're working remotely, retiring, or just want space and value, those tradeoffs often feel worth it. I'll give you a clear picture of what to expect so there are no surprises after you've signed.

## Who helps with Florence AZ real estate?

I'm Brian Butler with eXp Realty (License #SA701819000) and Florence is one of my two specialty markets. I know what's available, what's priced right, and what to watch out for. Reach me at 480-810-9255 or Brian@thebutlerrealty.com. No pressure, no pitch -- just honest answers.

## Is Florence AZ a good place to buy a home?

For the right buyer, yes. Florence is a strong fit for remote workers, people relocating from higher cost-of-living areas, buyers seeking more land than the metro can offer, and those interested in land investment. It's not the right fit for everyone -- and I won't tell you it is just to make a sale. Let's have an honest conversation about your situation and whether Florence actually makes sense for you.

## Thinking About Florence?

I've worked with buyers across Florence and know the residential market and land parcel landscape. Let's have a real conversation about whether this is the right fit for your goals -- no pressure, just honest answers.

## San Tan Valley vs Florence

The two markets serve different buyer profiles. Here's a quick comparison:

- San Tan Valley — Closer to metro, faster-growing, established communities, great for families

- Florence — More space, lower prices, land available, quieter, better for remote workers

Not sure which is right for you? That's exactly the kind of question I can help answer -- without any agenda.
